dedupe_keys.name: versatile electric vehicle charging profile generation tool for home charging scenarios for regional case study

description: Versatile electric vehicle charging profile generation tool for home charging scenarios for regional case study is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Venkatachalam Lakshmanan, Sigurd Bjarghov (NTNU Norwegian University of Science and Technology). These scripts can be used to create EV charging profile for home charging case for a given number of EVs with 15 minutes time resolution for the given number of days. Charging profiles can be used for different studies, for example voltage deviation in a distribution grid. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
